body.name: Paired-cell observed experiment
body.construction: For \(h\in H_m\), under \(P_{m,h}\), \(V\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\), \(J\sim\operatorname{Unif}\{1,\ldots,m\}\), and \(Z\sim\operatorname{Unif}\{-1,1\}\) are mutually independent; conditionally on \(X\), \(S\) and \(T\) are independent \(\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\); and \(B\mid X,S,T\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(p)\), where \(p=1/2\) if \(S=1\), \(p=p_0+Zh_{V,J}\) if \(S=0,T=V\), and \(p=7/18\) if \(S=0,T=1-V\). Set \(Y=1/2+B\) and \(P_{m,h}^{n}=\bigotimes_{i=1}^{n}P_{m,h}\).
